sentences.en: Doctors are not as a rule trained in child rearing.
sentences.zh: 医生通常不接受儿童抚养方面的培训。

sentences.en: Speak louder for the benefit of those in the rear.
sentences.zh: 大声点，为了让后排的人也能听清楚。

sentences.en: The girl is checking out the rear of the bicycle.
sentences.zh: 女孩在检查自行车的后部。
